Each process checks absence and then uses exclusive creation; both logs must show 'exclusive-created=1' and overlapping held intervals. An 'EEXIST' result is inconclusive, not concurrent creation. A matrix row is a specified check; qualification is established only by its linked result ledger.` | [direct R041](document-references.md#r041); [suite R001](document-references.md#r001); [governing R001](document-references.md#r001) |
| [Section: Repeat on each Mac, against its existing iCloud API test directory:](../IntegrationTests.md#L368) | NV_ICLOUD_API_TEST_TIMEOUT=30 /tmp/notation-integration-tests/ICloudAPIContractTest \ root-lock-directory "$ICLOUD_API_TEST_ROOT" ''' Independent exec'ed processes verify exclusion initially, after closing a separately opened catalog descriptor, after coordinated child-file creation/Foundation replacement, after directory rename and movement to another parent, and across a duplicated-descriptor handoff. Closing the last descriptor permits acquisition. A pipe-confirmed independent holder is killed with 'SIGKILL', after which another process must acquire. Recreating the old pathname deliberately produces a **different**, independently lockable directory: this positive control must not be interpreted as protection of a pathname or a replacement root. On a positively ubiquitous directory with an uploaded child, the probe also requests directory eviction, opens/locks it again, materializes the exact child bytes while locked, and repeats eviction/rematerialization while holding the lock. It records directory 'SF_DATALESS' separately from the child's not-downloaded status. **Child-only eviction does not establish directory-placeholder coverage.** That case still exercises child rematerialization and exclusion, but returns 2 to retain the stronger coverage gap. Eviction acceptance alone, refusal, and missing upload evidence are not successful lifecycle observations. The shared process/contender deadlines above apply, and synthetic subtrees are retained. Capture immutable committed note/action values using the existing batching policy. Sharing views does not introduce a per-keystroke segment or replace durability capture with window-close notifications. 4. Install locally on the existing durability lane. Each case must fail for the expected diagnostic category at the intended line, with a positive companion using the valid API. A missing module, unrelated syntax error, or linker failure is not successful enforcement evidence. Pin the compiler used for diagnostic matching and update expectations deliberately on toolchain changes. Source/API checks should also reject accidental escape hatches: public unchecked constructors, conformance of authority types to 'Decodable', unconstrained raw path publication, safety-disabling flags, and unreviewed unsafe annotations. Keep standalone legacy suites; qualify test-runner availability separately from the macOS 11.5 library/bridge executable. No third-party/duplicate test framework is needed. Keep synthetic fixture bytes, decoded values, exact canonical preimages, expected IDs, expected classifications, and provenance together. Encode large test integers as explicit decimal strings or byte encodings where JSON tooling could otherwise lose precision. Add deterministic generators for valid operations and DAGs, followed by targeted invalid mutations. Preserve seeds and minimize failures. Useful properties include equal complete histories reducing identically across delivery permutations; duplicate receipt being idempotent; transport repacking preserving operation identity; Current-only edits preserving unrelated alternatives; and restoration/compensation maintaining distinct births. Do not turn those into invalid global assertions: derived live notes are not monotonic because obsolete automatic preservation may retract, and an untouched copy’s eligibility can change as Deletes arrive. | [Section: First finding: fix the test's attribute-name contract](../tla/Incarnation-Metadata-Experiments.md#L112) | The older runtime's 'xattr_name_with_flags' omitted the unsupported 'ONLY_SAVING' bit: the same source call generated '#SX' on 26 but '#S' on 14, '#PSX' versus '#PS', and '#X' versus no suffix. The first peer inspection recomputed names locally and therefore queried different attributes. Direct inspection showed the original '#SX' attributes were present. Its missing-attribute conclusions were **test errors**, not provider failures. The harness now serializes exact originating names in 'origin.plist', validates them, and queries those names on the peer. It rejects older manifests without names instead of guessing. The desired 'ONLY_SAVING' intent behavior is observational on runtimes that omit the bit, not a failing Apple-contract assertion. Corrected fresh fixtures confirmed: - All five syncable source attributes, including the exact '#SX'/'#PSX' names created on 26, arrived with equal bytes on 14. The reverse run likewise preserved its exact five syncable names. Nonsyncable local-seal attributes did not arrive. - The fresh staged incarnation/revision values arrived and matched the corresponding new bodies. This is converged endpoint evidence, not proof of intermediate body/metadata atomicity. - '#NS' also traveled with sync despite the intent evaluator's never-preserve result. Preserve-for-copy/save intent evaluation is not a universal transport enforcement mechanism. | [Most critical properties / 1](../tla/Storage-Protocol-Audit.md#L11) | 1 — **Durable means recoverable, with all dependencies and action metadata.** Every acknowledged operation survives ordinary restart with its complete parent/action closure; an installed operation does not depend on a delivered callback. — A creates/edits, then issues a dependent Delete/Restore before earlier callbacks; B receives descendants before ancestors; either or both crash between installation, retained-pin update, application and receipt. No descendant is applied without its transitive ancestry. — DUR-01, START-01, HIST-01 Status: document-defined matrix check. | `Use the commands/implementation witnesses named in this section. | [Most critical properties / 2](../tla/Storage-Protocol-Audit.md#L12) | 2 — **Equal complete history yields equal logical meaning.** After finite input and eventual successful exchange/application, computers agree on live births, represented revisions, conflicts, Deletes and action eligibility independently of arrival order or duplicates. — Concurrent edits, multiple covering Deletes, explicit copies and compensations arrive in opposite orders, with stale cache/restart and later descendants. Exact effect/causal provenance, not merely note count, must agree. — HIST-01, DELETE-01, PUB-01 Status: document-defined matrix check. | `Use the commands/implementation witnesses named in this section. A matrix row is a specified check; qualification is established only by its linked result ledger.` | [direct R462](document-references.md#r462); [suite R001](document-references.md#r001); [governing R001](document-references.md#r001) |
| [Most critical properties / 3](../tla/Storage-Protocol-Audit.md#L13) | 3 — **Deletion respects intent, concurrency and birth boundaries.** Unexplained file absence is not a remote NV command; an applicable Delete removes its birth while preserving unobserved concurrent edits. Restore has a fresh birth. — One Mac deletes while another edits offline; a later Delete covers the first edit but not its extension; a restored note and a same-named replacement file exist before the old removal callback runs. Neither restoration nor unrelated bytes are erased. — DELETE-01, IMPORT-01, REC-01 Status: document-defined matrix check. | `Use the commands/implementation witnesses named in this section. | [Most critical properties / 4](../tla/Storage-Protocol-Audit.md#L14) | 4 — **Every authored action keeps its exact scope and value.** Note operations, before/after references and action metadata describe the same captured mutation; ordinary edits do not consume unrelated conflict heads. Undo/Redo targets actual compensations, not receipt order. — Two Macs undo the same candidate, each authors further work, one restarts, and the user reviews a compensation after remote changes. Complete groups recover together; siblings and unrelated fields survive; no-op compensation is not a completed action. — HIST-01, PUB-01, DUR-01 Status: document-defined matrix check. | `Use the commands/implementation witnesses named in this section. | [Most critical properties / 5](../tla/Storage-Protocol-Audit.md#L15) | 5 — **External-file races never become overwrite/removal permission.** A committed note update and a historical receipt are not proof of what occupies a filename now. — Remote segment arrives while an external editor safely replaces/renames the file and local NV has B→C pending; crash between destination install, source accounting and receipt. Preserve external bytes; advance only the actually settled projection; never clear C with B's completion. — DISC-01, AUTH-01, PUB-01, DELETE-01 Status: document-defined matrix check. | `Use the commands/implementation witnesses named in this section. | [Most critical properties / 6](../tla/Storage-Protocol-Audit.md#L16) | 6 — **Admission/retry identity is exact, without replaying consent.** One admitted observation is not repeatedly imported after receipt loss, even if its note is later edited/deleted. A changed preparation needs a new operation identity, not necessarily a new unused birth. — Preview changes during reservation; crash before/after operation durability and twice before receipt; deletion arrives during association review/completion; another file competes for the note. No repeated birth, mutation under an old operation ID, silent re-approval or attachment to a deleted birth. — IMPORT-01, REC-01, HIST-01 Status: document-defined matrix check. | `Use the commands/implementation witnesses named in this section. | [Most critical properties / 7](../tla/Storage-Protocol-Audit.md#L17) | 7 — **Private metadata and cleanup cannot lose the only retained input.** Payload/reference/receipt/pin ordering protects both possible complete metadata generations after an uncertain replacement. — New preview becomes durable while an older admitted input remains frozen; Local State replacement or cleanup fails; restart returns old or new metadata. Retained bytes and operation/settlement links remain usable; missing/unreadable source is not abandonment. — DUR-01, CLEAN-01, IMPORT-01, CKPT-01 Status: document-defined matrix check. | `Use the commands/implementation witnesses named in this section.
